title: Synthetic Data Exploration: Variational Autoencoders
summary: An NHSX Analytics Unit research project exploring Variational Autoencoders, with and without differential privacy, for generating synthetic health data (SUPPORT and MIMIC datasets). The repository runs SDV's CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula and TVAE synthesizers as comparison baselines and embeds a modified copy of RDT's transformer code to control the GMM transformer's random state.
evidence: sdv_baselines.py CLI: --model_type {CopulaGAN,CTGAN,GaussianCopula,TVAE}; rdt/transformers/numerical.py modified for random_state control
